title: Modbound (old)
description: a modpack that i made for me and my friends, adds some quality of life mods and other stuff
body:
[Modbound] - "bound to modifications we've made"

this is a modpack i made for me and my friends
this modpack adds a lot of quality of life mods and mods that make the game better overall, such as Create, The Aether, [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero, Corpse, and many more
i dont expect anyone outside of my friend group to find this, but if you do then you're welcome to download it to play minecraft with just a few changes
this is my first modpack so im not really sure what im supposed to do :P

- dani :)
